name: vertex-order-kit
description: Build-time only. Node drives scripts/ssr-render.js (`just build`'s SSR step) via jsdom; react/react-dom are pinned to the exact versions site/support.js loads from unpkg at runtime (site/support.js REACT_URL/REACT_DOM_URL), so the prerendered markup matches what the client re-renders. Never shipped to the browser.
